text:
maria: Quick perf dump from this morning's per-model sweep. Ran Llama-33B, Mistral-7B-v0, Mixtral-8x7B, and Qwen-14B across 2k/8k/32k contexts. Posting highlights + suspected regressions.

maria: TL;DR — Llama: KV cache prefetch helps at >8k; Mistral: attention kernel choice matters for batch>=8; Mixtral: RoPE scaling produced odd tail latency; Qwen: head-dim transpose kernel reduced latency for batch sizes 1-4.

ashwin: nice, numbers?

maria: pasted two important slices: throughput (tokens/s) median and p99 latency (ms) for single-GPU p4d-equivalent.

maria: 
```
Model        context  batch  tokens/s  p99_lat_ms
Llama-33B     2048     8     4200      85
Llama-33B     8192     8     2800     230  <- p99 spike w/o kv-prefetch
Mistral-7B    2048    16     7600      45
Mistral-7B    8192    16     3900     310  <- fallback to slow attn kernel
Mixtral-8x7B  8192     4     5000     260  <- RoPE fractional scaling regression
Qwen-14B      2048     1     1200      33
Qwen-14B      8192     1      420     180  <- improved with head-transpose kernel
```

li: that llama 8k p99 looks like KV miss + cache thrashing. What was kv cache config?

maria: default: kv_prefetch=false, kv_max_slots=10240, continuous_batching=true, batch_padding_strategy=truncate-to-max.

ashwin: can you re-run with kv_prefetch=true and kv_max_slots=32768? On long-tail context distribution prefetch avoids page-in spikes.

maria: re-ran quick: enabling kv_prefetch + kv_max_slots=32768 cut Llama 8k p99 from 230->95 ms and increased tokens/s 2800->3400. Added to the log.

rachel: for Mistral the fallback kernel is triggered by sequence length bucket + attention dim alignment. We should update kernel selector to prefer the AVX-optimized fused-softmax for seq<=4096 and the chunked kernel for >4096 unless batch*seq fits L2.

maria: agreed. The perfbot trace shows selector picked the naive kernel at 8k due to heuristic: prefer numerical stability. We can adjust the numeric stability threshold per model (mistral has better stability with mixed-acc).

perfbot: [perfbot] profiler-report attached: top 3 hot paths: attention_gemm, kv_copy, pos_emb_rope_apply.

li: Mixtral RoPE note: we saw amplitude drift when using fractional RoPE scale factor 0.75 on heads>64. The kernel for RoPE uses a packed sin/cos path that assumes head_dim%8==0; Mixtral's head layout triggers a slow fallback.

maria: fix idea: add head-aware RoPE path that handles non-8-aligned dims with vectorized remapping instead of scalar fallback. I prototyped it: p99 drops ~30ms for Mixtral 8k.

ashwin: for Qwen the head transpose kernel improvement — what changed?

maria: Qwen uses multi-head dims with large key dims. Default matmul kernel had poor cache locality for batch<=4. Transposing the query/key buffers per-batch and using blocked GEMM improved single-request latency. Code snippet we used: 
```
// simplified: batch transpose
for (b=0;b<B;++b) transpose_inplace(q[b], B_head, head_dim);
call blocked_gemm(q_blocked, k_blocked);
```

maria: that added ~20% latency reduction at batch=1 and avoided several p99 anomalies. But it increases memory churn for very large batch sizes so we gate it behind batch<=4.

rachel: actionable checklist?

maria: proposed action items: 
- Update kernel selector heuristics: model-specific thresholds (Mistral prefers fused-softmax under mixed-acc).
- Enable kv_prefetch for Llama by default when context>4096; increase kv_max_slots heuristically based on observed context histogram.
- Implement head-aware RoPE kernel to avoid non-8-aligned fallback for Mixtral.
- Add head-transpose path for Qwen gated by batch<=4.
- Add automated sweep job that runs 2k/8k/32k with sampled batch sizes and validates tokens/s + p99 and fails if p99 regresses >20%.

ashwin: +1. For the sweep job, include the real traffic context-length distribution (we have histograms in metrics) and run mixed-length workloads not just fixed-len.

li: also add a micro-benchmark for kv copy hotpath with different memory alignment/allocator strategies — small allocs are killers.

maria: will create a PR with: kernel selector tweaks, kv_prefetch toggle, and the Qwen transpose gate. I'll open a separate PR for the RoPE kernel (needs more testing).

rachel: assign owners?

maria: I'll take the kv and Qwen transpose PR. li will own the RoPE kernel changes. ashwin will add model-specific kernel thresholds into the selector and add the sweep job config.

perfbot: [perfbot] created issue INF-4782: "sweep: per-model 2k/8k/32k stability + kv/kern tweaks"

ashwin: cool. Please include benchmark scripts and the exact config used so we can repro.

maria: yeah I'll attach the runbook and the `run_sweep.sh` that calls `inference-bench` with: 
```
./inference-bench --model llama-33b --context 8192 --batch 8 --kv-prefetch true --kv-slots 32768 --kern-selector config/mistral_qwen.json
```

maria: anything else?

li: add a note to the rollout: enable changes behind feature flags for Dedicated customers first so we can watch unit-economics.

rachel: great thread. I'll file a follow-up to capture the new selector heuristics in the public docs for model profiles.

maria: thanks all. I'll post the PR links here when ready. :rocket:
